confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, price lists, or booking pages. The July 2026 window is beyond my knowledge cutoff, so 2026 levels are extrapolated from earlier Turkish price trends; lira inflation and alcohol-tax increases add volatility. Accommodation anchors are typical peak-season room rates, not all-inclusive, and carry the widest error. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the local draft-beer relationship (about 2x and 1.3x the beer anchor) because direct knowledge of current bar and wine prices is weak. The FX figure comes from the RBA daily exchange-rate table as seen in search excerpts, not from a live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Antalya is Turkey's main Mediterranean resort hub. Restaurant and bar anchors are benchmarked to other Turkish coastal resort towns such as Marmaris and Fethiye, and hostel and hotel anchors to mid-sized Mediterranean resort cities in lower-cost European markets. Region is Europe because Turkey is usually grouped with Europe in tourism and development classifications, although Antalya lies in Asia Minor.
